c1-24-01.title: Communicative Challenge: How the Study Was Done
c1-24-01.scenario: You have read a report about a research group. Károly asks whether the study was good.
c1-24-01.prompt: Tell Károly how the research group did its work.
c1-24-01.target: A kutatócsoport módszertanilag kifogástalanul végezte el a kísérleteket.
c1-24-01.english: The research group carried out the experiments in a methodologically flawless way.
c1-24-01.canDo: I can say how a study was done with an adverb (*módszertanilag*, *szisztematikusan*, *empirikusan*).

c1-24-02.title: Communicative Challenge: How the Discovery Was Made
c1-24-02.scenario: You have read about a discovery in a laboratory. Károly asks how the researcher got there.
c1-24-02.prompt: Tell Károly the steps of the discovery.
cues: Say what the researcher found first
Say what the researcher did next
c1-24-02.target: A kutató az anomáliákat feltárva és új kísérletet tervezve jutott el az áttöréshez.
c1-24-02.english: Uncovering the anomalies and planning a new experiment, the researcher reached the breakthrough.
c1-24-02.canDo: I can string the steps of a discovery with -va/-ve participles (*hipotézist felállítva*, *adatokat összevetve*, *anomáliákat feltárva*).

c1-24-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Theory and Evidence
c1-24-03.scenario: You have read about a new theory. Károly asks whether it is proven.
c1-24-03.prompt: Tell Károly what the theory was and what the measurements showed.
c1-24-03.target: Míg az elmélet csak feltevés volt, addig az új mérések bizonyítékot adtak.
c1-24-03.english: While the theory was only an assumption, the new measurements gave evidence.
c1-24-03.canDo: I can set a theory against the evidence (*míg az elmélet … addig a tapasztalat*, *ezzel szemben*, *nem puszta spekuláció, hanem tény*).

c1-24-04.title: Communicative Challenge: The Aim of the Study
c1-24-04.scenario: You have read about a research project. Károly asks why the researchers started it.
c1-24-04.prompt: Tell Károly why the researchers started the study.
cues: Say what they wanted to understand
c1-24-04.target: A betegség okainak megértése céljából a kutatók új vizsgálatot indítottak.
c1-24-04.english: In order to understand the causes of the disease, the researchers started a new study.
c1-24-04.canDo: I can state the aim of a study (*céljából*, *végett*, *érdekében*).

c1-24-05.title: Communicative Challenge: A Great Discovery
c1-24-05.scenario: You have read the text about Szent-Györgyi Albert. Károly asks how important a discovery can be.
c1-24-05.prompt: Tell Károly how a discovery can change a field.
c1-24-05.target: A felfedezés alapjaiban változtatta meg a tudományterületet.
c1-24-05.english: The discovery changed the field at its foundations.
c1-24-05.canDo: I can say how big a discovery is (*korszakalkotó módon*, *alapjaiban*, *vitathatatlanul*).

c1-24-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Summing Up the Research
c1-24-consolidation.scenario: You have read a report about a research project. Károly asks you to sum it up.
c1-24-consolidation.prompt: Tell Károly why the study was done and what it showed.
c1-24-consolidation.target: A betegség okainak megértése végett kutattak, és az új mérések bizonyítékot adtak.
c1-24-consolidation.english: They did research to understand the causes of the disease, and the new measurements gave evidence.
c1-24-consolidation.canDo: I can use the words for research method, proof and discovery.
